name: The front-pass scaffolding + emission layer (assurance-scaffolding, never verdict)
description: Andrew-direct via CTO~A (the mechanical front of the tool-check generalization). Turns the hand-run front pass from a per-tool re-derivation that dead-ends in prose into a repeatable, evidence-emitting procedure, so tools 4->62 are faster than 1->3 and every pass FEEDS the graph (a ToolAudit CSE per tool) instead of evaporating. THREE deliverables: (a) the recon-scaffolding SDK (the 8 fixed opening moves + the 12-shape failure taxonomy as a hunt-order + the archetype->probe map) plus a `comp-passcraft recon <tool>` helper that runs ONLY the mechanical moves and STOPS at the verdict door; (b) the ToolAudit CSE emission schema; (c) the accuracy fixes routed to CVO as rulings. LOAD-BEARING INVARIANT (sec.0): PASSCRAFT templates the SCAFFOLDING and the emission SCHEMA and NOTHING ELSE -- the verdict stays hand-run; a component that could emit a pass/fail has become the harness it replaced. AC1/AC4 exist to stop that shipping green. Consumes NFRA_TOOLPASS (the doctrine, CVO-owned) + NFRA_CSE (the emission contract); FEEDS NFRA_TOOLGRAPH (the ToolAudit stream is its node/edge source). Supersedes NFRA_COMPASSURANCE's *harness* (there is no harness -- TOOLPASS sec.0); builds the layer that was actually missing between the doctrine and the killed harness. Runs in PARALLEL with base-CTO's live hand-run pass -- it is that pass's scaffolding, not its replacement.
